name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) correctly ensures the switch is flipped before reaching the exit. The hard Existence(at_exit) is satisfied by the Precedence chain only if the task's goal was the flip, but since the exit is the primary command, the Existence(at_exit) is required; Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) correctly constrains the order.

texts: The agent must have flipped the switch before reaching the exit.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
